title: Adaptive Semi-supervised Learning for Cross-domain Sentiment Classification
answer_short: The architecture combines entropy minimization and self-ensemble bootstrapping, as described in Algorithm SECREF6.
answer_rationale: Text 3 explicitly states that 'DAS as shown in Algorithm SECREF6 denotes our full model' and that it combines both entropy minimization and self-ensemble bootstrapping. Text 4 further supports this by explaining that these techniques are employed as regularizations to incorporate unlabeled data in the model. The architecture is thus defined by these two components jointly employed in Algorithm SECREF6.
